title: Gf2mWideConfig<N> trait + Gf2mWide<N, Cfg> type shell
description:
Introduce the const-generic multi-word GF(2^m) type and its config trait. This is Task 1 of the 6fb4abad story breakdown.

## Scope

- `pub trait Gf2mWideConfig<const N: usize>: 'static` in new module `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide_config.rs` with:
  - `const M: usize` — extension degree (must satisfy `64*(N-1) < M <= 64*N`).
  - `const MODULUS: [u64; N]` — the low-order `M` bits of the irreducible polynomial (bit `M` implicit = 1).
  - Cached `MODULUS_HIGH_BIT_WORD` / `MODULUS_HIGH_BIT_MASK` or a default `fn` to derive.
  - Optional `const NAME: &'static str` for `Debug`.
- `pub struct Gf2mWide<const N: usize, Cfg: Gf2mWideConfig<N>> { words: [u64; N], _marker: PhantomData<Cfg> }` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs` with `Copy`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`, `Eq`, `Hash`, `Debug`.
- Constructors: `from_words` (debug-asserts tail mask), `new` (masks tail), `zero`, `one`, `from_u64`.
- Accessors: `words`, `bit(i)`, `is_zero`, `is_one`.
- `Add`, `Sub`, `Neg`, `AddAssign` (owned + `&`-RHS, matching `Gf2mElement_` boilerplate). `Neg` is identity (char 2). `Sub == Add`.
- Private helper `mask_tail_in_place`. Document as multi-word analogue of the tail-masking invariant.
- `mod.rs`: `pub mod wide;` + re-exports.
- A minimal test `Gf2m256TestConfig` citing a documented Seroussi pentanomial for `M = 256` (pick one from HPL-98-135 Table 1, e.g. `x^256 + x^10 + x^5 + x^2 + 1`).
- Unit tests: addition commutativity, `zero() + a == a`, `a - a == zero()`, tail masking zeroes bits above `M`.

## Success criteria

All items above implemented, `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`/`cargo test --release` clean.
